name: BazaarSwap MCP

tools.name: get_quote
tools.notes: Races the routing backend for up to ~35 s. For a swap into Cardano, recipientAddress (the Cardano address) is required or no route is found.

notes: Disclosure: published by Fortress Enterprises, which also maintains this taxonomy; listed by reviewed PR like any other server. Keyless: the API serves anonymous callers at a lower rate limit, and BAZAAR_API_KEY only raises it, so no tool declares env. The backend sleeps when idle; an empty quote is usually a cold start — retry once after ~30 s.
